title: viola tenuicornis subsp. baicalensis
intro: Viola tenuicornis subsp. baicalensis, commonly known as the Baikal violet, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the violet family (Violaceae). It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Viola tenuicornis subsp. baicalensis include its ability to calm inflammation, reduce fever, and relieve respiratory symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
